description: Used with `no-static-link`. Hint to the linker to load all members of static archives.
A general qualifier to enable building for a specific context (e.g., `build-os-linux`).
Qualifier to build a dependency only on a specific operating system.
Qualifier to build a dependency only for a specific build configuration (e.g., `Debug`, `Release`).
`no-craft-os-<os>`: Ignores a dependency when crafting on the specified host OS.

`no-craft-platform-

`: Ignores a dependency when crafting for the specified platform.
`only-craft-release`: Forces a dependency to be built in `Release` configuration.
`no-craft-sdk-<sdk>`: Ignores a dependency when crafting for the specified SDK.
`no-dependency`: Prevents building this if the `--no-dependency` flag is specified.
`no-dynamic-link`: Forces the project to be built as a static library (`--library-style static`).
`only-framework`: Indicates that the project is a framework, affecting build phases.
`no-inplace`: Builds the project in a temporary directory and then "dispenses" it to the final location.
`only-liftheaders`: Passes the `--lift-headers` option to `mulle-dispense`.
`no-mainproject`: Marks a dependency as a subproject.
`no-memo`: Prevents the build result from being recorded, forcing it to be rebuilt every time.
A general qualifier to enable building for a specific platform.
`no-require`: Ignores a dependency if its source directory is missing.
`no-require-configuration-<c>`: Ignores a missing dependency for a specific configuration.
`no-require-os-<os>`: Ignores a missing dependency on a specific host OS.

`no-require-platform-

`: Ignores a missing dependency for a specific target platform.
`no-require-sdk-<sdk>`: Ignores a missing dependency for a specific SDK.
`no-rootheader`: Installs headers into a subdirectory named after the project during dispense.
`no-singlephase`: Allows a project to be built in parallel using multiple phases (header, compile, link).
`only-standalone`: Builds a standalone library (`--library-style standalone`).
`no-static-link`: Forces the project to be built as a dynamic library (`--library-style dynamic`).
Specifies the maximum SDK version the dependency can be built with.
Specifies the minimum SDK version required to build the dependency.
